The '''Assembly Defender Droid AR-18''' was a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] manufactured by the [[Okara Droid Company]]. A number of AR-18 units were deployed to protect the assembly line at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
